note: libs/atlas-packet is a shared wire-codec library, not a DDD domain service; DOM-01..20/FILE-*/SUB-*/EXT-*/SCAFFOLD-* checklists are not applicable (no processor.go/resource.go/entity.go/REST surface). Only codec-relevant checks were run, per the audit brief.

checks.name: No duplication of atlas-constants types
checks.evidence: character_temporary_stat.go:12 imports character.TemporaryStatType from libs/atlas-constants; no new type/const declarations in the diff.

checks.name: Every new writer has an exact mirroring reader
checks.evidence: character_temporary_stat.go:324-329 (MobSkillReasonForeignValueWriter) mirrors :368-372 (Reader); :336-342 (ValueMobSkillReasonForeignValueWriter) mirrors :374-379 (Reader). Pinned by TestCTSForeignDiseaseCarriesMobSkillKey and TestCTSForeignPoisonCarriesValueThenMobSkillKey against literal IDA-derived bytes.

checks.name: Old ValueSourceLevelForeignValueWriter/Reader cleanly removed
checks.evidence: git show 780040742 shows deletion; repo-wide grep for ValueSourceLevelForeignValue returns zero hits post-diff.

checks.name: EncodeForeign/DecodeForeign iterate in the same order including legacyGmsMask and baseStatNames branches
checks.evidence: character_temporary_stat.go:1073-1109 (EncodeForeign) and :1272-1301 (DecodeForeign) both call sortForeign(keys) before branching on legacyGmsMask; both filter via the same package-level baseStatNames map (:1081, :1280). sortForeign tie-break by unique Shift() (:1046-1054) rules out sort.Slice instability.

checks.name: foreignRank fallback (unnamed stats sort last by shift) is safe
checks.evidence: TestForeignReadOrderCoversEveryValueCarryingStat (character_temporary_stat_test.go) proves every non-named, non-base stat writes 0 bytes for all 12 pt.Variants, so the fallback tail never carries live bytes.

checks.name: Guard test version coverage vs. the canonical 9-version matrix
checks.evidence: pt.Variants (libs/atlas-packet/test/context.go:18-41) is a superset of the 9 canonical matrix versions in docs/packets/PROCESS.md:38-39, plus legacy v28/v48 (legacyGmsMask path) and extras v86/v92. GMS v12 (template exists) is absent from both the matrix and pt.Variants but is a pre-existing, unrelated gap.

checks.name: foreignReadOrderIndex init-order / mutability
checks.evidence: character_temporary_stat.go:1065-1071, IIFE depends on foreignReadOrder (:991); Go dependency-orders package var init regardless of source order. Single write site (init), read-only thereafter.

checks.name: New writer/reader export-ness matches file convention
checks.evidence: All *ForeignValueWriter/*ForeignValueReader funcs in the file are exported (character_temporary_stat.go:276-379); new funcs follow suit. New helpers sortForeign/foreignRank are unexported, matching legacyGmsMask/writeMask/isGmsV61 convention.

checks.name: New tests pin real wire bytes, not tautologies
checks.evidence: TestCTSForeignDiseaseCarriesMobSkillKey, TestCTSForeignPoisonCarriesValueThenMobSkillKey, TestCTSForeignOrderMatchesClientReadOrder assert literal byte sequences derived from IDA evidence, not encoder-vs-itself.

checks.name: Round-trip tests' scope is honestly bounded
checks.evidence: pt.RoundTrip (libs/atlas-packet/test/roundtrip.go:22-34) only proves encode/decode self-consistency; investigation.md section 5 explicitly discloses the live two-client verification was not performed.

checks.name: Non-disease stat ordering change disclosed, not silent
checks.evidence: sortForeign applies to all non-base foreign-value-carrying stats (character_temporary_stat.go:1079-1086), not just diseases; commit message's 'any two value-carrying stats' framing and investigation.md section 3's full-sequence verification table cover this breadth explicitly.

checks.name: Pre-existing non-disease mismatches correctly deferred, not silently dropped
checks.evidence: investigation.md section 6 and docs/TODO.md (new atlas-packet section) both document ShadowPartner truncation, BanMap on gms_v48, v95 Mechanic/DarkAura/BlueAura/YellowAura NoOp mismatch, and gms_v61 missing Confuse branch.

checks.name: Disease-writer reassignment covers exactly the 9 documented diseases
checks.evidence: character_temporary_stat.go:98-101,116-117,133,145 reassign Stun/Seal/Darkness/Poison/Weaken/Curse/Seduce/Confuse; Slow explicitly kept NoOp with rationale at :118-125; Undead stays a base/two-state stat, never reaching the foreign per-stat writer path.

nonBlocking: 4 pre-existing non-disease foreign-codec mismatches disclosed in investigation.md section 6 / docs/TODO.md remain open for a future task (ShadowPartner truncation, BanMap gms_v48, v95 Mechanic/DarkAura/BlueAura/YellowAura, gms_v61 Confuse).
GMS v12 seed template exists but is absent from both the 9-version coverage matrix and pt.Variants -- pre-existing, unrelated to this commit.

Live two-client verification from the original issue's repro was not performed; substituted with literal-byte + IDA cross-reference tests, explicitly disclosed as an open item in investigation.md section 5.
